title: PC will not turn on
symptom: No lights or fans when the power button is pressed
user_description: My computer is completely dead. I press the power button and nothing happens at all, no lights, no sound.

options.why: Far too expensive and premature. Nobody has yet checked whether the PC is receiving power.
Impossible and pointless. A PC that is not powered on cannot be reinstalled, and Windows is not the cause.

options.text: Check the power cable, power strip switch and wall socket, and test the socket with another device
options.why: No lights at all usually means no power is reaching the PC. A loose cable, a switched-off power strip or a dead socket are the most common causes.

options.text: Replace the power supply unit immediately
options.why: A faulty power supply is possible, but it should only be suspected after the cable, strip and socket have been ruled out.

hints: Are there any lights or fans at all?
What is the very first thing a PC needs before it can start?
real_world_tip: Always check the power strip first. Cleaners and desk moves often switch it off or knock plugs loose.
